title: Introduce query-clustering-driven regression shield and adaptive-anchor reweighting
author: Aisha Kapoor
description: Motivation: Large prompt sets often hide concentrated regressions that are diluted by overall aggregate metrics. This PR adds a CI hook that clusters queries by semantic similarity, computes cluster-level regression signals, and applies an adaptive-anchor reweighting policy so noisy or overly-large clusters cannot mask meaningful failures. Design summary: 1) query_clusterer module computes embedding-based clusters using existing embedder + configurable clustering algorithm (kmeans or agglomerative with dynamic cluster count), 2) cluster_anchor_store keeps deterministic anchor examples per cluster and maintains historical baselines, 3) cluster_shield_hook runs as part of the eval CI stage, comparing current cluster metrics (accuracy/semantic-f1/custom scores) to historical baselines with an outlier-aware p-value test, 4) when a cluster exceeds thresholds the hook triggers a targeted rerun on that cluster with cross-seed sampling, and 5) an adaptive-anchor reweighter adjusts cluster contributions to the global SLO to avoid dominance by large low-variance clusters. Integration: adds a new GitHub Actions job eval/clustered-regression that runs after the baseline eval job, exposes config via eval_harness.yaml under "cluster_shield" with parameters: cluster_algo, min_cluster_size, baseline_window_days, pvalue_threshold, rerun_backoff. The hook is backward-compatible: disabled by default and can be enabled per-repo or per-prompt-set. Implementation notes: - Uses existing lightweight embedding cache to avoid recomputing embeddings for large prompt-sets. - Deterministic seeding for clustering to ensure reproducible CI behavior. - Adds a small synthetic benchmark (benchmarks/cluster-demo.jsonl) used by unit tests to exercise edge clusters. - Provides metrics: cluster_count, clusters_flagged, reruns_triggered, per-cluster-delta. Risk & mitigation: additional CPU/embedding cost on CI (~+1.2s per 1000 queries for small datasets) but clustering is limited to a configurable sample size and cached artifacts are uploaded between CI steps. The rerun path uses exponential backoff and rate-limits to avoid CI storms. Backwards compatibility: no breaking changes; default disabled. Documentation: added docs/ci/clustering_regression.md and updated README with configuration examples. Testing: unit tests and an integration smoke test added. See files_changed for specifics and conversation thread for review notes, fixes, and final approval.

conversation: Marco Liu (reviewer): Strong design; two asks: 1) make clustering seed deterministic across runs and 2) add a small-cpu fallback when embeddings are disabled in private deploys.
Aisha Kapoor (author): Addressed. Added deterministic seeding and a 'lightweight' lexical-cluster fallback when the embedder is unavailable; documented in clustering_regression.md.
Evan Park (reviewer): CI cost looks ok but please cap the default sample size and ensure logs are redact-safe (no raw user data).
Aisha Kapoor (author): Default sample capped at 2k queries; anchor store only keeps hashed indices, logs sanitized. Added test to assert no PII in uploaded artifacts.
Sofia Rinaldi (reviewer): Request a backoff on reruns to avoid repeated failures from flakiness. Also suggest exposing pvalue_threshold as env override.
Aisha Kapoor (author): Implemented exponential backoff with jitter and added env var override; added test for backoff behavior.
CI: initial run - lint failed (flake8 E231), unit tests passed. Author pushed fix. CI: rerun - all checks passed.
Marco Liu (reviewer): Approved after fixes. Evan approved. Sofia requested one final minor doc tweak which was applied. Maintainer merged with squash.

release_notes: Add query-clustering CI hook that finds cluster-level regressions and triggers targeted reruns; introduces adaptive-anchor reweighting to improve failure localization. Disabled by default; opt-in via eval_harness.yaml. Includes docs and tests.
performance_impact: Adds ~+1.2s per 1000 queries for small prompt-sets when clustering is enabled; configurable sample cap and embedding cache reduce recurring cost.
test_summary: Unit tests cover clustering algorithm, anchor persistence, rerun backoff, and config parsing. Integration smoke test verifies CI action runs and artifacts are uploaded. All tests passed in CI after lint fix.
